confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.no_devices_found: No Moonside lamps found in range of a Bluetooth proxy.

set_theme.name: Set theme
set_theme.description: Run a theme/effect with your own colours. The number of colours each theme uses is fixed (see the catalog); extra colours are ignored, too few raises an error.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: The theme code from the catalog.

color.name: Colour 1
color.description: First colour (for themes that use colours).

color2.name: Colour 2
color2.description: Second colour (themes with 2 or more colours).

color3.name: Colour 3
color3.description: Third colour (themes with 3 or more colours).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Only for RAINBOW1/RAINBOW2 (animation speed instead of a colour).

set_pixel.name: Set pixel
set_pixel.description: Set one addressable LED to a colour (PIXEL command). The strip has 172 LEDs, numbered 0 to 171.

set_backled.name: Set back-light section
set_backled.description: Set one of the two back-light sections to a colour (BACKLED command).

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Send a literal ASCII command to the lamp (Nordic UART).

command.name: Command
command.description: The exact command, e.g. COLOR255000000 or THEME.RAINBOW1.20,
